name: No Worktrees
description: Stops Orca from creating Git worktrees so you work in each project's main checkout. Folder workspaces are not affected.

settings.title: Worktree creation
settings.description: Block: refuse every new Git worktree unless its project is listed below. Off: let Orca create worktrees as usual.

settings.title: Projects that may still create worktrees
settings.description: Project ids, separated by commas or new lines. Run `orca repo list --json` to see them.
